name: Trivia World Quest
summary:
Knowledge becomes adventure.

Step into Trivia World Quest, a unique VR experience that transforms classic trivia into an immersive journey of exploration, discovery, and challenge.

Travel through beautifully crafted worlds filled with mysteries, puzzles, and interactive environments. Answer questions across multiple categories including Science, History, Geography, Nature, Sports, Literature, and Entertainment to unlock new paths and progress through the adventure.
